structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by Boards Within the Department of Health Professions

law.catch_line: Distribution of drugs in Schedules II through VI by manufacturers and wholesalers

text.section: A permitted manufacturer or wholesaler may distribute drugs classified in Schedule III through Schedule VI and devices to all persons listed in subsection A of this section without an official written order. However, this section shall not be construed to prohibit the distribution of a Schedule VI drug or device to any person who is otherwise authorized by law to administer, prescribe or dispense such drug or device.
